meta.note: SQLite page_size study. Two parts, both SQLite-only, disk-backed scratch, same host as per-instance-run.json: (a) a five-point sweep at page_size 4096/8192/16384/32768/65536, and (b) three replicates each at 4096 and 32768 to establish whether the difference clears the noise - it does, with disjoint ranges (warm chunk-read p50 medians 452.5 vs 286.5 us, 1.58x). Each record carries params.sqlite_page_size and params.sweep. Absolute latencies are NOT comparable with per-instance-run.json: the same default config reads ~452 us in a standalone run and ~656 us inside the 8-engine sweep, so only within-context ratios are trustworthy.
